people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

translations.web: Behold, he was more honorable than the thirty, but he didn’t attain to the three; and David set him over his guard.
translations.bsb: He was most honored among the Thirty, but he did not become one of the Three. And David appointed him over his guard.
translations.kjv: Behold, he was honourable among the thirty, but attained not to the first three: and David set him over his guard.
translations.asv: Behold, he was more honorable than the thirty, but he attained not to the first three: and David set him over his guard.
